newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japanese government concerned about Nomura case.
newsitem.headline: Japanese government concerned about Nomura case.

text.p: The Japanese government is concerned about the situation regarding Nomura Securities Co Ltd, Japan's top government spokesman said on Friday.
"It is a very worrisome problem," Seiroku Kajiyama told reporters.
Nomura, Japan's largest securities brokerage, announced on Thursday that two of its directors had been involved in an "apparently irregular" deal with a corporate client.

Speaking on the broader subject of the economy, Kajiyama said that a report this morning by the Economic Planning Agency showed that the Japanese economy is on a recovery trend, although the pace of the recovery is moderate, while private sector demand is firm and there are signs of improvement in the job market.
